title: docs(cli): the `os migrate stored-expressions` row still says a rollback or revert does not fill (stale since #32700)
body:
domain:skills#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5pjSPT7ui2EUcunaVb

Filing gate: ① (a follow-up owed by work in flight: the at-tier delta review of PR #33589, card #32703, record 6888043840, read this outside its diff and left it to the owning lane).

`content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` line 1473 (the `os migrate stored-expressions` row) says the command is also "for a rollback or revert, which does not fill". That is stale on `main`. `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-stored-expression-fill.ts` (the #32700 block) says the history doors now fill the same way a publish does: `rollbackMetaItem` (`POST /api/v1/meta/:type/:name/rollback`), `revertCommit` (`POST /api/v1/packages/:id/commits/:commitId/revert`) and `rollbackToPackageCommit` (`POST /api/v1/packages/:id/rollback`). Since #32958, `deleteMetaItem` removing an `object_extension` that re-declared a stored computed field fills after its registry heal too.

## What lands

1. The cli.mdx row stops naming rollback and revert as cases the command is for. It names the history doors and the extension-removal delete among the changes that fill at the change, or says only "a save in publish mode, a publish, or a rollback/revert", in the doc's own register.
2. Read the same claim elsewhere in `content/docs/**` (grep `does not fill`, `rollback`, `stored-expressions`) and fix any copy that repeats it.

Docs wording only, no behaviour change. The published skills (`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md` after #33589) say "rows a publish did not fill" and stay true either way.

## Reader

Whichever lane owns `content/docs/deployment/**` (docs or devx). Sized p3.
